Build an infusion ring and make lasting equipment.
Build one Infusion Table, eight Plinths and nine supports.
Craft an Infusion Table, eight Plinths and nine Soul Stone supports.
Infusion uses a fresh soul bottle offered by hand. It does not need a worker or Soul Well.

Use the preview to build a 7×7 layout. Put Soul Stone under the table and all eight plinths. Every work surface must be at the same height.\
\
The north, east, south and west plinths have two empty blocks between them and the table. Diagonal plinths are two blocks away along each axis.

Put the listed ingredients on the eight plinths in clockwise order: N, NE, E, SE, S, SW, W, NW. You can rotate the whole pattern; keep its order.\
\
A soul rune appears when the recipe is ready. Right-click the table with the required fresh soul bottle. The ritual takes ten seconds.

Take the floating output with an empty hand, or use a hopper below the table. Each batch takes one item from every plinth stack. The spent bottle drops at the table.\
\
Clear the output before offering another soul. An invalid recipe spends nothing.

Right-click a plinth to add one held item. Empty-hand use retrieves its whole stack. Hoppers can load or empty it.\
\
Breaking a required block during a ritual returns its reserved ingredients and soul at the center. Unloaded chunks pause the ritual.

Check the nine supports, all eight plinth positions and the clockwise item order. Clear any waiting output.\
\
Start with [Crystallized Soulbone](entry://anima:codex/infusion/crystallized_soulbone): four Blue Crystals, four Soulbones and one Benign soul.
Nine Soul Stone supports, eight Plinths and one Infusion Table. All work surfaces share one height.
Infuse four Blue Crystals and four Soulbones with one Benign soul.

Crystallized Soulbone is used for Soulbone armor, Raw Saronite and Spirit Thread.\
\
[Build the infusion ring](entry://anima:codex/infusion/ritual) before starting.
Gather a Diamond and a Doomed soul to make Raw Saronite.
Take Raw Saronite to a [Soul Forge](entry://anima:codex/infusion/forge) supplied by a Soul Well. A regular furnace cannot smelt it.
Smelt Raw Saronite in a Soul Forge supplied by a Soul Well.

Place a Soul Forge within 32 blocks of your stocked Soul Well.\
\
Place Raw Saronite in Input. It becomes a Saronite Ingot after ten seconds, costs 5 worker durability, and gives 2 experience.

The forge also smelts normal furnace recipes at their usual speed, using 5 worker durability per item. It uses worker souls instead of fuel. An Infernal worker lasts 30 durability; other kinds last 20.\
\
Hoppers feed from above or the sides and collect below. Ordinary furnaces cannot smelt Raw Saronite.
Craft a Saronite Sword to harvest souls in combat.

Craft Saronite tools directly; no smithing upgrade is needed. Saronite tools match Netherite damage, speed and 2,031 durability. Repair them with Saronite Ingots.\
\
Use the sword or Saronite Arrows to harvest souls away from a cage.

For ordinary souls, land the killing Saronite Sword strike or Saronite Arrow. A player carrying an empty glass bottle catches the soul automatically; otherwise a spirit appears for later capture.\
\
Bows, crossbows and dispensers fire Saronite Arrows. The killing arrow decides whether harvesting occurs. Undead have no ordinary souls.

God Souls require a direct killing strike with the Saronite Sword and an empty glass bottle in your inventory. Arrows cannot harvest them, and no loose spirit appears if you lack a bottle.\
\
Sources: Ender Dragon, Wither, Warden, Elder Guardian and summoned god avatars. The Wither is the undead exception.\
\
See [Nine Soul Kinds](entry://anima:codex/soulwork/types).
Optional: make durable armor before upgrading it to Saronite.

Infuse each armor piece separately using its linked infusion recipe. Soulbone armor has diamond-level protection, toughness and durability, plus 5%% knockback resistance per piece.\
\
Repair it with Crystallized Soulbone. It accepts normal armor enchantments and is the base for Saronite armor.
Optional: upgrade Soulbone armor with Saronite and Netherite.

Upgrade each Soulbone armor piece separately. Open its connected entry for the infusion recipe.\
\
The upgrade preserves enchantments, custom name, trim, anvil history and existing damage. Repair Saronite armor with Saronite Ingots.

Helmet: 4 armor\
Chestplate: 9 armor\
Leggings: 7 armor\
Boots: 3 armor\
\

Optional: collect five God Souls for permanent flight.

You need five God Souls in total.\
\
Carry the finished ring to fly in Survival. Double-tap jump to start flying, then use jump to rise and sneak to descend.

A dropped Ring of Power never despawns. Only lava destroys it; fire, explosions and ordinary damage do not.\
\
Removing the ring stops its flight ability and gives ten seconds of slow falling if you are airborne. A running Flight spell continues normally.
